murder-on-the-aurora-dawn.title: Murder on the Aurora Dawn
murder-on-the-aurora-dawn.tagline: A steampunk murder mystery adventure for 5th Edition
hook: When the airship Aurora Dawn is three days from port, one of its wealthiest passengers turns up dead in a locked stateroom — and the killer is still aboard. Your party has until the ship docks to sort suspects from scapegoats, unravel motives tangled in old debts and older grudges, and catch a murderer before they slip away into the crowd at landing.

locationsSpotlight.name: The Grand Dining Hall
locationsSpotlight.description: Where the body is found — and where alibis start to crack.

mapsSpotlight.name: Full Deck Battle Map
mapsSpotlight.description: VTT-ready and print-ready, gridded for combat and roleplay alike.

npcSpotlight.name: Mr. Aldous Renner
npcSpotlight.description: He swears he never left the smoking room — but the porter remembers seeing him near the stateroom, coat still damp from the deck.

the-carnival-of-forgotten-smiles.title: The Carnival of Forgotten Smiles
the-carnival-of-forgotten-smiles.tagline: Uncover the dark secrets behind a mysterious carnival in this thrilling one-shot for 5E.
hook: A traveling carnival rolls into town overnight, its tents lit and its performers smiling — but the smiles never seem to move, and nobody in town remembers inviting it. When a local child goes missing after the opening show, your party has one night to find out what the carnival really is before it packs up and vanishes for good.

locationsSpotlight.name: The Hall of Mirrors
locationsSpotlight.description: Step inside, and every reflection smiles back a little too wide.

mapsSpotlight.name: Carnival Grounds Map
mapsSpotlight.description: VTT-ready and print-ready, laid out tent by tent for easy exploration.

npcSpotlight.name: The Ringmaster
npcSpotlight.description: He remembers every visitor's name — even the ones who never told him.
